verdict.rationale: PagerDuty's Post-Incident Reviews start directly from the resolved incident. They draw on the incident lifecycle, Slack data and the Scribe Agent to build chronological narratives and coordinate follow-up actions, and the GA changelog describes AI-generated PIRs. However, the evidence never explicitly shows AI drafting contributing factors or a draft-then-human-review flow, so story coverage is incomplete. missing for 10: explicit evidence that AI drafts contributing factors / root-cause analysis, documented human-review-of-draft workflow, detail on what the AI-generated PIR draft contains, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, AI drafts the postmortem from the incident record — timeline, contributing factors, follow-ups — ready for human review

citations.quote: Teams can start PIRs directly from the incident detail page or Slack after resolving an incident

Post-Incident Reviews integrate with your incident lifecycle, Slack data, and the PagerDuty Advance Scribe Agent to help your team uncover systemic patterns, build chronological incident narratives, and coordinate preventative follow-up actions
Transcribe incident meetings in real time to enhance incident summaries and post-incident reviews
generative AI for summarizing key information about an incident
